title: Hybrid Identity with Active Directory & Microsoft Entra Connect
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (identity foundation: AD ↔ Entra synchronization via Entra Connect, authentication method, hybrid join, higher risk to the identity plane).
hook: One identity, on-prem and in the cloud — synchronized, secured, and reliable
problem: Most organizations still run Active Directory on-premises while their apps, devices, and security live in the cloud. If the bridge between them is misconfigured, you get duplicate accounts, broken sign-ins, and devices that won't join properly. This solution establishes solid hybrid identity with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra Connect — reliable synchronization, the right authentication method (password hash sync, pass-through authentication, or federation), hybrid Entra join, and the health monitoring to keep it that way.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the hybrid identity model, Microsoft Entra Connect (Connect Sync vs. Cloud Sync), authentication methods (PHS, PTA, federation), seamless SSO, hybrid Entra join, and synchronization health.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Active Directory, Entra ID licensing, an Entra Connect host, the authentication method decision, UPN/domain hygiene, network) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: prepare AD and domains, install and configure Entra Connect, choose and enable the authentication method, scope synchronization, enable hybrid Entra join, validate sign-in and sync health, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — AD/identity readiness discovery, synchronization and sign-in validation, a sync-health and object-coverage report, safe remediation of sync errors/duplicates (-WhatIf default), and a sync-scope helper.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Establish solid hybrid identity with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra Connect — reliable synchronization, the right authentication method, hybrid Entra join, and health monitoring. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
